reviews_to_answer.review_text: Everytime I’ve come in, people are loitering and by people I mean the homeless population. My last straw was when a homeless man cat called a women and she left from being so uncomfortable. I don’t get it??? A lot of potential here but it just reeks and the spots are taken for hours by those who are not there to enjoy coffee.

Nice coffee shop. Good drinks. I come here sometimes to study. Putting three stars due to today and seeing an interaction between staff that was a little uncomfortable. A worker came in about an hour late and the woman barista behind the counter publicly began chastising him and speaking/almost yelling about how she “was supposed to leave and I had to call someone because of you not responding and how irresponsible..” etcetera. I understood her frustration but was embarrassed for the guy + her that she couldn’t calmly talk to him away from all of us customers. This went on for a solid 10 minutes.

The coffee was decent, but not as great as elsewhere downtown. The space is nice and the service was good. We didn't eat anything. Better than most, as Fargo has a lot of bad greasy spoons and donut shops, but we missed another that was highly recommended.

Came in here on a busy morning and was pleasantly surprised how smooth everything went. The line moved quick, and the staff still took time to be friendly. I ordered an iced latte and it tasted fresh, not watered down like some places do. The coffee had a nice strong flavor without being bitter. Inside was clean and had a relaxed vibe, good spot to sit for a bit. Prices were pretty normal for this area. Only small thing was seating filled up fast, but overall a really solid coffee shop I'd come back to.

I just had a $6 or $7 sandwich called the sausage,egg and cheddar cheese McMuffin. Soo Soo fire. I mean that sandwich you would really have to eat slow. I am so happy and feeling good. I would be back for more. Thanks again
Great food there
